definitions.explanation: A ceremonial head ornament worn by royalty or nobility.
The top part of the head.
The upper component of a kanji character.

examples.japanese: {王様|おうさま}は{金|きん}の{冠|かんむり}をかぶっている。
examples.english: The king wears a golden crown.

examples.japanese: この{漢字|かんじ}の{冠|かんむり}は「うかんむり」だ。
examples.english: The crown radical of this kanji is 'ukanmuri'.

examples.japanese: {月桂冠|げっけいかん}を{頭|あたま}に{載|の}せた。
examples.english: They placed a laurel wreath on their head.
